_note: The repeat gate must know a value sits under the band BEFORE anything is sent downstream, so the threshold is read out of the third-party engine's OWN DOCUMENTATION (source.kind='vendor-documented') and never obtained by running it. engine/ imports nothing from skills/lab-results/.
_units: `unit_conversions` maps a REPORTED unit onto a multiplier into `unit`. It exists because QE F2 (MEASURED 2026-08-05) found the gate comparing a bare number against the band: `230 ng/dL` — about 8 nmol/L, plainly under the <12 band — was ADMITTED with withheld_reason null. A unit with no declared conversion is UNCOMPARABLE and fails closed; it is never silently treated as being in the band's own unit.

unit_conversions_source.citation: Testosterone C19H28O2, molar mass 288.43 g/mol. 1 ng/dL = 1e-8 g/L ÷ 288.43 g/mol = 3.467e-11 mol/L = 0.03467 nmol/L; 1 ng/mL = 100 ng/dL = 3.467 nmol/L. DERIVED arithmetic, not a measurement and not a claim about any patient — the `нмоль/л` and `nmol/l` entries are the same unit spelled differently and carry the identity factor 1.
